goal: NS Cloud Drive v2.0 — Architecture Specification & Autonomous Expansion (VPS SSH Connection, Remote Agent File Sync, Proton Drive, MEGA, S3/Metal, Reverse Webhook, Sync Pairs, and Intelligent Cloud Deduplication)
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Author comprehensive Version 2.0 Engineering Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP-v2.md) detailing VPS SSH/SFTP integration, remote agent large-file sync, Proton Drive, MEGA, S3/Metal, and multi-platform expansion.
2. Implement VPS / Remote Server provider engine (src/providers/VpsProvider.ps1) supporting SSH/SFTP keys, password auth, DPAPI storage, and full ProviderContract compliance.
3. Implement Proton Drive provider engine (src/providers/ProtonDriveProvider.ps1) adhering strictly to all 7 ProviderContract functions.
4. Implement MEGA (20 GB E2EE) and S3 / Metal object storage provider engines (src/providers/MegaProvider.ps1, src/providers/S3Provider.ps1) with DPAPI protection.
5. Register all 6 providers in src/providers/ProviderContract.ps1 and author comprehensive test suites verifying contract satisfaction and security.
6. Build high-concurrency HTTP reverse webhook server (src/services/AgentWebhookServer.ps1) on port 5998 with MTA Runspace for remote agent alerts.
7. Implement on-the-fly pre-transfer stream compression in AgentTransferBridge.ps1, Invoke-AgentTransfer.ps1, and ProviderConnectionWindow.ps1.
8. Implement automated folder synchronization pairs (src/services/SyncPairManager.ps1, scripts/Invoke-SyncPair.ps1) with debounced FileSystemWatcher.

9. Implement intelligent cloud deduplication and restart-durable delta classifier (src/services/CloudDeduplicationService.ps1, scripts/Invoke-CloudDeduplication.ps1) preventing redundant uploads across all providers.
10. Wire all providers, webhooks, sync pairs, and deduplication into SettingsManager.ps1, VirtualDriveManager.ps1, CloudTransferManager.ps1, ProviderConnectionWindow.ps1, and NSCloudDrive.ps1.
11. Recompile native x64 Windows executable NSCloudDrive.exe (v2.0.0.0) with .NET 4.8 csc.exe and recompute SHA-256 checksum.

12. Update full documentation suite (README.md, docs/USER_GUIDE.md, docs/ROADMAP-v2.md, docs/PROJECT_STATE.md, docs/COMPATIBILITY-MATRIX.md, docs/engineering/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/engineering/INCIDENTS_AND_FIXES.md, .agents/architecture/ISSUE_TRACKER.md).
13. Execute all 50 automated regression test suites ensuring 100% pass rate (50 passed, 0 failed).
14. Maintain strict 1:1 granular commit and push protocol for every changed file per explicit owner directive.

decisions.decision: Implement pre-transfer format discrimination and exact byte-size matching in CloudDeduplicationService.ps1.
decisions.rationale: Prevents redundant re-upload of files already in the cloud while ensuring converted formats (e.g. .png vs .jpg) or edited contents are correctly flagged and re-sent.

decisions.decision: Persist cloud deduplication inventory to %LOCALAPPDATA%\NSCloudDrive\cache\cloud-dedup-ledger.json across device restarts.
decisions.rationale: Eliminates user wait times after rebooting their computer or re-adding large folders to the transfer queue.

decisions.decision: Utilize local WinFsp virtual drive roots for ultra-fast deduplication inventory indexing.
decisions.rationale: Indexes tens of thousands of remote files in under 30 ms without consuming cloud API calls or network round trips.

decisions.decision: Deploy background MTA Runspace HttpListener for reverse remote agent webhooks on port 5998.
decisions.rationale: Allows remote AI agents on VPS to notify the desktop app of build completions and transfer progress without blocking WPF UI dispatcher thread.

decisions.decision: Expand provider registry to 6 storage backends: Google Drive, TeraBox, Linux VPS, Proton Drive, MEGA (20 GB E2EE), and S3/Metal object storage.
decisions.rationale: Delivers universal cloud drive mounting capabilities across major zero-knowledge, public cloud, and object storage ecosystems.

reviewFindings.finding: Verified zero non-ASCII bytes in src/NSCloudDrive.ps1 and 100% strict-mode compliance across all 50 PowerShell modules.

securityFindings.finding: All MEGA, S3, VPS, and Proton credentials encrypted using Windows DPAPI with exclusive user/SYSTEM ACLs. Zero secrets exposed in logs or console output.
